extra_vocab.en: a thin book with pictures and information about a product or service
extra_vocab.note: 這句在問宣傳手冊的目標讀者是誰，用來確認內容與語氣要寫給誰看。brochure 是行銷與產品簡介常見的印刷品，intended audience 是常和它一起出現的說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: brochure 是可數名詞，單數要加 a／the；介紹的內容用 about 或 for，如 a brochure about the new model、a brochure for our services。

example.en: We printed two thousand brochures for the trade show next month.
example.zh: 我們為下個月的商展印了兩千份宣傳手冊。

example.en: Please attach the product brochure to your email to the client.
example.zh: 請把產品簡介手冊附在寄給客戶的電子郵件裡。

example.en: Our marketing team will design a brochure for the new service.
example.zh: 我們的行銷團隊會為新服務設計一份宣傳手冊。

example.en: Visitors can request a brochure at the front desk or online.
example.zh: 訪客可以在櫃檯或線上索取宣傳手冊。

examples.en: Who is responsible for updating the brochure before the product launch?
examples.zh: 產品上市前，由誰負責更新宣傳手冊？

examples.en: We handed out brochures to every visitor who stopped at our booth.
examples.zh: 我們把宣傳手冊發給每位在攤位停留的參觀者。

examples.en: The hotel brochure lists all the meeting rooms and their prices.
examples.zh: 飯店的簡介手冊列出所有會議室與價格。

confusable.diff: procedure 是「程序、步驟」，字尾拼法與發音和 brochure 相近；brochure 是印刷的宣傳手冊。

example.en: Please follow the safety procedure written in the training manual.
example.zh: 請遵守訓練手冊上寫的安全程序。

similar.diff: pamphlet 是較簡單的摺頁或薄冊，常用來提供資訊；brochure 多用於行銷，版面較精美。

example.en: The clinic gave us a pamphlet about the new health program.
example.zh: 診所給了我們一份有關新健康計畫的小冊子。

similar.diff: flyer 是單張傳單，多用於活動宣傳；brochure 是多頁或摺頁，內容較完整。

example.en: We put a flyer on every desk to announce the sale.
example.zh: 我們在每張桌上放了一張傳單來宣布特賣。

example.en: Please check the catalog for the full list of available colors.
example.zh: 請查看商品目錄，了解所有可選的顏色。

example.en: I will give everyone a handout at the start of the session.
example.zh: 課程開始時，我會發給每個人一份講義。

example.en: The poster for the sales event hangs in the main lobby.
example.zh: 銷售活動的海報掛在大廳。
